messages:
maria: Quick sync: new edge case - customer revoked retention consent after we stored a tiny debug prefix. How should console/audit handle purge + transparency?
owen: Need a revocation API that marks blobs 'revoked' and triggers selective purge job. Also update tenant dashboard to show revoked count + purge status.
tara: Legal: we must show a clear timeline: when consent granted, when revoked, who requested it. Purge must be auditable and irreversible.
phil: Ops: purge has to be async and non-blocking. Plan: mark, enqueue delete, emit metric retention.purge.enqueued, retention.purge.completed. If purge fails, escalate.
sec-bot: security-scan: ensure purge deletes all decrypted copies and removes indexes that could reconstruct fingerprints. Ticket SEC-7001.
audit-bot: Audit rule: create an entry for revocation request with actor, timestamp, affected blobs, and final purge result.
maria: Console UX: show "consent withdrawn" badge and a one-click "request purge" for admins; show progress. Also provide CSV export of affected request IDs for customers.
owen: Implementation: add /v1/tenants/:id/retention/revoke POST which returns job id. Job walks storage, deletes blobs, and removes search index entries. We'll require SSO auth and admin role.
tara: Also require customer-signed revocation confirmation for any purge of blobs that previously required customer consent. Log signature hash in audit.
phil: We'll include safeties: a dry-run mode that lists blobs to be purged before actual delete. Default UI does dry-run first.
maria: Good. I'll write a short RFC + UI mock and include SEC-7001/audit requirements. If no major objections I'll PR tomorrow.
owen: I'll own the endpoint + background worker. Add unit tests for job retry and metric emission.
sec-bot: please attach KMS purge confirmation steps and ensure key material isn't needed to prove deletion.
audit-bot: thread closed by maria
